text: 国庆假期首日文旅消费券热度增4倍，中国游客入住全球超2000个城市的酒店 国庆假期首日出游需求集中释放，国内景区门票、境外游及自然风光类体验订单量显著增长，多城串游、反向旅游及智能出行等新模式成为推动文旅消费的新动力。
text_en: On the first day of the National Day holiday, cultural tourism consumption voucher popularity increases 4-fold; Chinese tourists check into hotels in over 2,000 cities worldwide. Travel demand was concentratedly released on the first day of the National Day holiday, with domestic scenic spot tickets, overseas travel and natural scenery experience orders growing significantly; new models such as multi-city tours, reverse tourism and smart travel have become new drivers of cultural tourism consumption.
